title: Docklight Creator Co
text:
Docklight Creator Co

notes:
Lead source: inbound signup from blog post on creator workflows. Self-serve trial started 2026-02-28, used free credits but exhausted test tokens on 2026-03-02.

Top-level ask: stay on Hosted API (public cloud), want to push product feature demo to creators next week. Two procurement questions: can we pay by invoice for a $3k startup grant reimbursement? If not, will Redwood accept a credit-card + invoice backup? Also asked about startup discount stacking and whether free credits can be extended for 14 days — "we need more time to run throughput tests with real prompts".

Technical/UX notes: team is small (mobile/web app), typical request pattern ~20 reqs/sec during demo, target p95 latency <250ms for 256-token prompts. Sensitive to per-token cost; will test with smaller model variants. No on-prem/VPC required.

Security/compliance: requested SSO/SAML details and audit log example (for creators billing visibility). SOC2 not mandatory but they asked whether logs can be exported for accounting.

Timeline (short):
- 2026-03-01: AE intro email + billing options sent (Gmail thread thread-1700012345).
- 2026-03-02: 30-min product call (Fireflies FF-20260302-6843). Demo of Hosted API, set up test keys.
- 2026-03-04: Ran throughput test, hit token exhaustion. Asked for credits extension.
- 2026-03-06: Legal asked about invoice for startup grant; emailed procurement checklist.
- 2026-03-10: Follow-up call with SE (Liam) re: p95 targets and batching guidance.

Quotes/Customer voice: "If we can get a short invoice path for our grant, we can move to a paid plan quickly" — Product Lead.

Next steps / short-term plan: AE to confirm invoice feasibility or explain CC-only policy, SE to provide batching suggestion doc and recommended rate-limit config, Finance to review startup discount eligibility. Aim for decision by 2026-03-20.

Stitch notes: likely convert to paid self-serve if invoice/discount handled; otherwise will continue trial and may evaluate OpenAI/Cohere price points.

next_step:
Confirm billing path (credit card vs invoice), approve 2-week free credits extension, finalize rate limits for beta

blockers:
Need invoice option for grant reimbursement
Startup discount code required for legal sign-off
Budget owner (CEO) out until 2026-03-15
